title: Tenants' Protection Law [Consolidated Version], 5732-1972
source_id: Sefer HaChukim 5732 (ס״ח תשל״ב), p 176 — the נוסח משולב (consolidated version); the underlying original is חוק הגנת הדייר at ס״ח תשי״ד, 92. Wikisource page: חוק הגנת הדייר
verified_how: The obvious page name חוק הגנת הדייר [נוסח משולב] returns HTTP 404 on Wikisource; found the real page by a namespace-0 search on he.wikisource.org, which returned חוק הגנת הדייר and a separate חוק הגנת הדייר (מוסדות ציבור), plus six sets of תקנות הגנת הדייר. Fetched the page and its raw wikitext. Page title is exactly חוק הגנת הדייר; the heading prints the full title as חוק הגנת הדייר [נוסח משולב], תשל״ב–1972, and the rendered header attributes the consolidated version to ס״ח תשל״ב, 176. Note honestly: the FIRST citation box in the wikitext is {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשי״ד, 92|חוק הגנת הדייר|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/2/law/2_lsr_211796.pdf}}, which is the 1954 Law as originally published, not the 1972 consolidated version — so the official_url recorded above is the 1954 publication and a separate Reshumot PDF for ס״ח תשל״ב, 176 was not located. Section 162 of the consolidated version sets its commencement at 1 Cheshvan 5733 (9 October 1972). Highest-year amendment box is ס״ח תשפ״ג, 21, https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_1783627.pdf. Consolidation last edited 28 December 2025. On scope, read ss 9 and 10: both turn on whether premises had an entitled tenant on 26 Av 5728 — the text opens "נכס שביום כ״ו באב תשכ״ח (20 באוגוסט 1968)" — excluding premises vacant on that date unless later let with key money.
notes: OPERATIVE BUT RESIDUAL, AND NOT THE RIGHT INSTRUMENT FOR AN ORDINARY RESIDENTIAL TENANCY. It has not been repealed and is still applied, but only to protected tenancies (דיירות מוגנת) — overwhelmingly legacy key-money tenancies, plus rent-controlled business premises, with the ss 9-10 gateway tied to the position on 20 August 1968 and to key money having been paid. A tenant who signs a residential lease in Israel today is governed by סימן ו׳ of the Hire and Loan Law, 5731-1971, not by this Law; indeed the Fair Rent chapter expressly excludes premises that are under this Law, which is the clearest textual confirmation that the two regimes are disjoint. Keep it in the corpus because protected tenancies are still litigated and because the exclusion in the Hire and Loan Law cannot be encoded without it — but do not let it stand as the tenancy statute. Much of its operative detail (permitted rents for business premises, repairs, service charges) is in the six sets of תקנות הגנת הדייר made under it, which are subordinate legislation and were not verified here. A companion Law, חוק הגנת הדייר (מוסדות ציבור), exists as a separate Wikisource page and was not verified.
